effects.effect:
[Censors](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/class/censor) are the will of their god made physically manifest, and you act as your god's agent in the world. As you shoulder that responsibility, you choose a [censor order](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/censor-order) from the following options, each of which grants you a skill. (*Quick Build:* Paragon.)

- **Exorcist:** You specialize in hunting your order's hidden enemies, knowing that an open mind is an unguarded fortress. You have the [Read Person](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.interpersonal/read-person) skill.
- **Oracle:** Corruption has deep tendrils that can be missed, leading you to specialize in uncovering clandestine threats to your order. You have the [Magic](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.lore/magic) skill.
- **Paragon:** Without a strong example and a firm hand, the weak will be corrupted. You specialize in setting an example for your order. You have the [Lead](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.interpersonal/lead) skill.

Your [censor order](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/censor-order) is your [subclass](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/subclass), and your choice of order determines many of the features you'll gain as you gain new levels.
